events.text: Prada acquired 51% of the Helmut Lang company.

events.quote: In 1999 , Milan-based fashion house Prada acquired 51% of the Helmut Lang company

events.text: Mr. Lang sold his remaining shares to Prada.

events.quote: after Mr . Lang had sold his remaining shares to Prada in October 2004

events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: he left his own label in January 2005

events.text: Prada Group announced that Link Theory Holdings of Tokyo would be acquiring the Helmut Lang brand.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On March 17 , 2006 , Prada Group announced that , after six loss-making years , Link Theory Holdings ( LTH ) of Tokyo would be acquiring the Helmut Lang brand

events.text: It had been rumored that Prada was trying to sell the label.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Already in spring 2005 , it had been rumored that Prada was trying to sell the label

events.text: LTH re-launched the Helmut Lang collections for the spring/summer 2007 season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: re-launched the Helmut Lang collections under the direction of a suitable designer for the spring/summer 2007 season

events.text: The collections were presented in fall 2006.
events.subject: self

events.text: It was announced that Michael and Nicole Colovos had been installed by Link Theory as creative directors for the new Helmut Lang brand.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In May 2006 , it was announced that Michael and Nicole Colovos , an American-New Zealand designer couple , who formerly had their own Los Angeles-based denim label Habitual , had been installed by Link Theory as creative directors for the new Helmut Lang brand

events.text: Select upscale retailers started to carry the spring/summer 2007 Helmut Lang contemporary sportswear collection.
events.subject: self
events.object: spring/summer 2007 Helmut Lang contemporary sportswear collection
events.quote: From February 2007 , select upscale retailers such as Barneys or Bergdorf Goodman started to carry the spring/summer 2007 Helmut Lang contemporary sportswear collection

events.text: Link Theory expected to generate US$ 8 million in revenues with the label.

events.text: Link Theory expected to make a profit with the label.
